The '''Grand Avenue''' was the major access route between the [[o'beki]] of [[Graith]] and [[Graith starport]]. Although steep, the route was ten [[Meter/Legends|meters]] wide but did not include any guardrails. Vehicles traversed the Grand Avenue around the clock, and one [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] [[j'ber]] had cornered the market by running a passenger and cargo taxi service along the route. The Grand Avenue was named after the triumphal processional on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] of the [[Grand Avenue|same name]], but it gained its name sarcastically.
